build_byok_authorize_html: build the 2-step BYOK OAuth authorization page HTML with server name, access items, and API key form
test_verify_pkce: test the PKCE code verifier against a code challenge using SHA-256 and base64url encoding
review_byok_authorize_get: review the GET endpoint that shows the BYOK API-key entry form with OAuth parameters
create_byok_authorize_post: create the POST endpoint that stores a temporary authorization code and redirects with code and state
create_byok_token: create the POST endpoint that exchanges an authorization code for a short-lived BYOK session JWT token
